content.content:
Apply to the dependent's recorded text, read against the seven prerequisites as each is recorded at check time. The dependent passes only if all three criteria hold; fail on any missing element or contradiction, naming the element and, where it applies, the prerequisite. There is nothing to run.

1. License. No element of the dependent contradicts a prerequisite. Read the dependent clause by clause against each prerequisite; fail on every contradicting element — naming the element and the prerequisite clause it contradicts.

2. Independent weight. Every prerequisite in depends_on carries at least one element of the dependent, and no element leans on a prerequisite for a property that prerequisite does not state. Fail if a listed prerequisite carries no element, or if an element takes from a prerequisite a grant that prerequisite does not make — naming the element and the prerequisite.

3. Grounded addition. Where the dependent states something no prerequisite states, the text presents it as the dependent's own; it never presents a rule as granted, implied or applied from a prerequisite that does not state it; and where it takes a property a prerequisite fixes, it takes that property rather than narrowing it or deciding it again. Fail on an element attributed to a prerequisite that does not record it, or on an element that narrows or re-decides a property a prerequisite already fixes — naming the element and the prerequisite.
content.rationale:
The dependent is prose — its commitment is an admission rule stated in words — and six of its prerequisites are prose while the seventh is recorded as a requirement sentence. So six edges take the natural-to-natural cell's license read and the seventh is the same gate form in a matrix default cell (structured parent, prose child), flagged for a matrix entry; the child is on the natural side throughout, so no cell here permits a behavior probe and the check is a reading of the dependent's recorded text against each prerequisite, not a test.

One read-through settles the seven edges together, and criterion 2 keeps each edge load-bearing: the trunk rule and its requirement-sentence restatement fix the refusal the dependent extends and the set that refusal covers; the store node fixes the trunk by place and the resolution of that root from the invocation workspace, which is what lets an out-of-trunk invocation be refused on admission rather than on a failure to find the trunk; and the four discard nodes fix what a discard is, what it is invoked as, which change it takes away and what it does to the draft's workspace. Criterion 1 is where contradiction would show: a dependent that grounds its admission on a graph write, or on any effect a prerequisite denies, departs from the recorded clause and is named against it.

Criterion 3 carries the use this edge most needs. The trunk rule's refused set is defined by writing graph state, and it explicitly keeps the registry writers — draft opening and draft listing — outside that set because they write no graph state; the requirement sentence restates the same set and the same exclusion. So the discard admission is not granted by either of them, and the dependent must present it as its own addition rather than as an application of the trunk rule. Criterion 2's second half and criterion 3 also keep the dependent from narrowing or re-deciding properties those prerequisites already fix, and criterion 2 keeps a listed prerequisite from standing in for one that actually carries the element.
